global.title: Aerospacelab to supply satellite platforms to Lockheed Martin
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Satellite manufacturer Aerospacelab won a contract to supply two spacecraft platforms to Lockheed Martin, adding a major U.S. defense contractor to its customer base.
